title.es: Informe sobre un asunto del barrio

es: Presentar un problema local con estilo nominal en un informe breve y explicarlo después con frases verbales sencillas.

teaching.en: The main issue is the increase in traffic outside the school.
teaching.es: El problema principal es el aumento del tráfico frente a la escuela.
teaching.explanationEs: El informe nombra el asunto con un sustantivo: the increase in traffic.
segments: The main issue is the increase
teaching.audioText: The main issue is the increase in traffic outside the school.

teaching.en: The figure shows a rise of thirty per cent in two years.
teaching.es: La cifra muestra una subida del treinta por ciento en dos años.
teaching.explanationEs: Figure y a rise of introducen datos con un estilo nominal.
segments: The figure shows a rise of
thirty per cent in two years.
teaching.audioText: The figure shows a rise of thirty per cent in two years.

teaching.en: The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents.
teaching.es: La falta de un paso de peatones ha llevado a dos accidentes.
teaching.explanationEs: La causa (the lack of a crossing) y el resultado (accidents) se unen con has led to.
teaching.audioText: The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents.

teaching.en: Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate.
teaching.es: Nuestra propuesta es la instalación de un paso de peatones cerca de la puerta.
teaching.explanationEs: Proposal abre la solución y installation la nombra como sustantivo.
segments: Our proposal is the installation of
teaching.audioText: Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate.

teaching.en: In conclusion, this recommendation would bring an improvement in safety.
teaching.es: En conclusión, esta recomendación traería una mejora de la seguridad.
teaching.explanationEs: In conclusion cierra el informe y would bring marca el efecto esperado.
teaching.audioText: In conclusion, this recommendation would bring an improvement in safety.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del informe presenta el problema con un sustantivo?

choices.text: The main issue is that traffic increases.
The main issue is the increase in traffic.
Traffic is the main issue because it grows.

feedback.es: El estilo nominal convierte increase en el sustantivo an increase in traffic y lo usa como núcleo de la frase.

hint.es: Busca el sustantivo derivado de increase seguido de in.

prompt.es: Completa: «Nuestra propuesta es la instalación de un paso de peatones.»

feedback.es: Propose pasa a proposal: es el sustantivo que presenta la solución.

hint.es: Es el sustantivo de la solución que ofreces al final del informe.

origin.text: Our ___ is the installation of a crossing.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La cifra muestra un aumento del treinta por ciento.»

answer.text: The figure shows an increase of thirty per cent

feedback.es: Con porcentajes se usa of: an increase of thirty per cent; el sujeto es the figure.

hint.es: Empieza con The figure y usa of antes del número.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une la causa con el resultado?

choices.text: Two accidents have led to a lack of crossing.
The crossing has led to a lack of accidents.
The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents.

feedback.es: La causa es la falta del paso de peatones y el resultado son los accidentes; has led to los une en ese orden.

origin.text: Causa: no hay paso de peatones. Resultado: ha habido dos accidentes.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del informe con su explicación oral.

feedback.es: Cada sustantivo del informe se dice oralmente con un verbo: venir, no haber, instalar y haber menos.

prompt.es: Escribe la propuesta como frase formal con un sustantivo.

answer.text: The installation of a crossing near the gate is our proposal.
accepted: The installation of a crossing near the gate is our proposal.
Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate.

feedback.es: Install pasa a installation y la propuesta se presenta con un sustantivo.

origin.text: Propuesta: «Queremos instalar un paso de peatones cerca de la puerta.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ocurre frente a la escuela según el audio.

choices.text: More cars come and there is no safe place to cross.
Fewer cars come because there is a new crossing.
The school has closed because of the traffic.

feedback.es: El audio presenta el aumento del tráfico y la falta de un paso de peatones: más coches y ningún lugar seguro para cruzar.

origin.audio: There has been an increase in traffic outside the school, and the lack of a crossing is a big problem for children.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hay una falta de aparcamiento cerca de la estación.»

feedback.es: Lack se combina siempre con of: a lack of parking.

origin.text: There is a lack ___ parking near the station.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase desempaqueta «The opening of the crossing led to a fall in accidents»?

choices.text: They closed the crossing, so there were more accidents.
They opened the crossing, so there were fewer accidents.
The accidents opened a new crossing.

feedback.es: Opening esconde open y a fall in accidents esconde «hubo menos accidentes»: abrieron el paso y bajaron los accidentes.

prompt.es: Escribe un informe formal de 60 a 120 palabras con los datos dados.

answer.text: The main issue is the increase in traffic outside the school. The figure shows a rise of thirty per cent in two years. The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents, and there is also a lack of parking. Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate and a waiting area for cars. In conclusion, this recommendation would bring an improvement in safety.
accepted: The main issue is the increase in traffic outside the school. The figure shows a rise of thirty per cent in two years. The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents, and there is also a lack of parking. Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate and a waiting area for cars. In conclusion, this recommendation would bring an improvement in safety.

The main issue is the increase in traffic near the school. The figure shows an increase of thirty per cent in two years. The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents, and there is a lack of parking. Our proposal is the installation of a crossing near the gate and a waiting area for cars. In conclusion, the recommendation would bring an improvement in safety.

feedback.es: El informe presenta el problema con increase, la causa con lack of y el resultado con has led to, y cierra con proposal, installation, conclusion y improvement.

origin.text: Datos del barrio: hay más tráfico frente a la escuela (un treinta por ciento más en dos años). No hay paso de peatones y ha habido dos accidentes. Faltan plazas de aparcamiento. Propuesta: instalar un paso de peatones cerca de la puerta y crear una zona de espera para los coches. Con esto habrá más seguridad. Escribe el informe con estilo nominal: problema, causa, propuesta y conclusión.

evidenceGroups: increase in the number of cars

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del informe usa la preposición fija correcta?

choices.text: There was a reduction of in the number accidents.
There was a reduction at the number of accidents.
There was a reduction in the number of accidents.

feedback.es: Reduction se combina con in: a reduction in the number of accidents. Las otras opciones mezclan las preposiciones o el orden.

prompt.es: Explica el problema en voz alta con verbos, sin sustantivos de acción.

answer.text: There is no crossing, so two accidents happened.
accepted: There is no crossing, so two accidents happened.
There is no crossing and two accidents have happened.

feedback.es: Al explicarlo oralmente, the lack of a crossing vuelve a ser there is no crossing y has led to se convierte en so.

origin.text: Informe: «The lack of a crossing has led to two accidents.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone el informe.

choices.text: Build more crossings near the school.
Close the school for a week.

feedback.es: El audio dice «an increase in the number of crossings»: la propuesta es que haya más pasos de peatones.

origin.audio: Our recommendation is an increase in the number of crossings near the school.
